title: Rating Rule Card: Collision Reports of a Reported Resident Listed Before Exclusion (Owner Auto Policy)
content:
**Accident relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, an accident relativity multiplies the listing share of a household resident listed on the Owner Auto Policy before exclusion. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The relativity counts the claim reports of the term, on the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim file, that name the resident as operator with a collision cause. A collision cause is either a collision with another vehicle or a single-vehicle collision.

| Such claim reports | Relativity |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.45 |
| one | 1.25 |
| none | 1 |

**Reading the count (hypothetical).**
- One report naming the resident for a collision with another vehicle, plus one for a single-vehicle collision, counts two reports: 1.45.
- A report naming the resident for a glass or theft loss is not a collision cause and does not count.
